[[File:Ray Bordier DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Ray Bordier at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Ray Bordier''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 91 from Philadelphia, PA.<ref name="sm-fan" /> His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Bordier finished 12th in the [[Young Jedi]] Qualifier.<ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001205134500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>
